label_basis: Expected impacts were labeled from the read-only GitHub PR #1 diff at head 1622163cffab9d5e1f3cb32647f3c7dea73d5764. The browser test scope was read from config/default/behavior.json. Review these labels before using scores as a release gate.

expected_impacts.statement: The checkout summary submits a trimmed code through Saleor checkoutAddPromoCode, handles transport and GraphQL errors, and on success clears the input and requests a checkout refresh.
When checkout data contains an applied voucher, the summary displays its code and discount name; removal calls checkoutRemovePromoCode, handles errors, and refreshes checkout after success.
The checkout page supplies the network-only checkout refresh callback to both mobile and desktop order summaries.

observed_behavior_scope: The browser scenario added a product, navigated to checkout, and asserted the checkout URL, discount-code input, and Apply button were visible.
The browser scenario did not submit a voucher, verify a backend mutation, verify a rejected code, remove an applied voucher, or check recalculated totals.
